# Evals (web)

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs` from the code. Edit the code comments, not this file. -->

Evaluation suites and their cases and runs.

## Files

- `EvalSuitePage.vue`: One evaluation suite: its cases, its runs, each answer and whether it passed, and raising issues from the failures.
- `EvalsPage.vue`: Evaluations and red teaming: the suites that test AI systems themselves, with their last result against a pass threshold.

## Pages

| Address | Page |

| `/evals` | `EvalsPage.vue` |
| `/evals/:id` | `EvalSuitePage.vue` |

The server side is in [`apps/server/src/evals`](../../../../server/src/evals/README.md).
